structure.label: Case and source
structure.help: Start with the case identifier so the report can be traced back to its source.

structure.content: **Exercise only.** Use reserved addresses and harmless content. A filled form structures a report; it does not establish maliciousness or publish the event.

structure.label: Case reference
structure.help: Your internal case or ticket identifier, for example DOC-2026-001.

structure.label: Email and attachment
structure.help: Capture message context and describe the attachment without executing it.

structure.label: Reported email
structure.help: Record the observed values exactly. The exercise uses reserved examples; review IDS flags before using any data for detection.

structure.label: Attachment metadata
structure.help: Record the observed values exactly. The exercise uses reserved examples; review IDS flags before using any data for detection.

structure.comment: The reported email carried the described attachment. Repeatable fields link their first instances only.

structure.label: Analyst assessment
structure.help: Separate observations from an assessment and record what to do next.

structure.label: Initial triage note
structure.help: Describe the source, the evidence and what remains uncertain.
structure.default_content:
## Source
User report; assessment pending.

## Assessment
Describe the observations, uncertainty and next action.
